Name: Daycare Attendants NPC
Author: GhostsInABox
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8]This mod adds Sun and Moon from the FnaF series as NPCs with the option to romance!  this mod is the unofficial branch of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26432?tab=description]this one.[/url][/color]


[color=#D4D4D8]While these two are known for being close among the other townsfolk, and while they do prefer each others company, there is still an air of tension around them initally.[/color]




[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]While this mod right now is just a repost, I will be updating it here and there to rework it a little and add extra features to it, stay tuned! [/size][/color]



[color=#D4D4D8]Free Love is an optional mod. if you wish to marry both of them, its required.[/color]


[color=#D4D4D8][size=3][b]Thanks again to MelodyArtiez for permission to take up this project, and for your extra support. [/b][/size][/color]
